# exiv2 / fuzz-read-print-write

exiv2's own fuzz target `fuzz-read-print-write` ([source](source/fuzz-read-print-write.cpp), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over exiv2 (Exiv2/exiv2 at e84cb9db).

readMetadata; print every Exif/IPTC/XMP datum; printStructure in six modes into a string stream; writeMetadata back into the in-memory image; nothing compared.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against exiv2 at commit e84cb9db.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- ImageFactory::open must never return a null image (it throws on unknown formats instead) ([line 14](source/fuzz-read-print-write.cpp#L14)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.
